description: BlurHash decode vectors (T3-39, docs/specs/T3-39.md, Test plan). Each decode vector's pixels are [x, y, r, g, b] of a 32x32 decode with punch 1, alpha 255; a decoder passes within +-1 per channel. Every refuse vector decodes to nothing.

source.reference: woltapp/blurhash, TypeScript/src/decode.ts, base83.ts and utils.ts at commit 712a47f946b98c30097eb1ada086ea00b18681ec (2024-05-21), read through the GitHub API on 2026-11-23

source.method: The reference decoder was run once at 32x32, outside the repository, by the T3-39 test writer; only its numbers are committed, no code of it

decode.from: 1x1 (flag 0), DC 0x000000 (black): every pixel is the DC colour, derived by hand; the reference agrees
1x1 (flag 0), DC 0xFFFFFF (white): every pixel is the DC colour, derived by hand; the reference agrees
1x1 (flag 0), DC 0x336699 (a mid blue): every pixel is the DC colour, derived by hand; the reference agrees
the reference README's example hash (4x3, numX x numY); pixels from the reference decoder at 32x32
a 9x9 hash of 166 characters built for this file: flag 80, quantised maximum 40, DC 0x4A6B8C, AC k (1 to 80) = (k * 2311 + 97) mod 6859; pixels from the reference decoder at 32x32
packages/core/tests/fixtures/jellyfin/12.4.0/home-latest.json, ImageBlurHashes.Primary["id-2"] (4x5, numX x numY); pixels from the reference decoder at 32x32

refuse.why: a space, outside the 83-character alphabet (README hash, character 11 replaced)
U+00E9, non-ASCII, outside the alphabet (README hash, character 11 replaced)
a double quote, outside the alphabet (README hash, character 11 replaced)
30 characters where the size flag (4x3) asks for 28
